_comment: The gate is a going-forward ratchet: a NEW offender fails, and an entry here that no longer
offends ALSO fails, so this file cannot silently overstate the remaining debt.

baseline entry. The renames: engagement-mode__chip -> engagement-mode__icon (a decorative
aria-hidden glyph wrapper, the .hiw-mode__icon shape), team-member__chip -> team-member__avatar
(the headshot frame — the name its --horizontal sibling already used).
